sloka: ये मां वाक्यान्तरे ब्रूयुरनुनेतुं कथञ्चन ।अहिता नाम ते नित्यं मदभीष्टविघातनात् ।। ७.४५.२१ ॥
transliteration: ye māṁ vākyāntare brūyuranunetuṁ kathañcana ।ahitā nāma te nityaṁ madabhīṣṭavighātanāt ।। 7.45.21 ॥

translations.english: Those who would speak to me with other words, attempting to persuade me in any way, are indeed always my enemies because they obstruct my desire.
